fieldValues.value: Replace valueType with orthogonal fieldType facets

A Field needs independently composable semantic facets. Extending a single valueType enum while retaining parallel patch properties would leave datatype, cardinality, domain, format, and constraints ambiguous and unable to describe the metamodel coherently.
A Field expresses datatype, cardinality, value domain, format, and constraints as independent fieldType facets instead of extending the conflated valueType enum with more parallel patch properties.

- Keep valueType and add composite as a ninth enum value.
- Keep separate contentFormat, allowed-values, validation-rule, and repeatable mechanisms.
All Field definitions required a breaking, scripted definition-layer migration and existing readers temporarily could not load them.
Review before adding a fieldType facet or compatibility mechanism that re-couples independent semantic concerns.
